# finishes

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:finishes`](gmeow-finishes.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/finishes>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Allen FINISHES: this event and the related event end together, and this one began later (it is a final sub-span). NOT transitive. Inverse of [`gmeow:finishedBy`](gmeow-finishedBy.md). (= [time:intervalFinishes](http://www.w3.org/2006/time#intervalFinishes); TimeML ENDS; TEO finishes.)

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use when two events end together and this one began later — a closing act that finishes a festival (the Allen FINISHES link, a final sub-span).

### Avoid when

- Avoid confusing it with mereological [`gmeow:subEventOf`](gmeow-subEventOf.md) (temporal extent, not part-of) and avoid expecting transitive closure; finishes is non-transitive.

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:finishes`](gmeow-finishes.md) between the co-ending [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) occurrences and read [`gmeow:finishedBy`](gmeow-finishedBy.md) as its inverse.

### Examples

- ex:closingAct [`gmeow:finishes`](gmeow-finishes.md) ex:festival.
